title: The Mad Hermit
text: A hermit sits in a cave mouth, wild-haired and wild-eyed, a rusty spear across his knees. He says he is keeping one of your Lost safe inside, safe from the things out there and safe from you. He will not give them back. You can hear someone breathing in the dark behind him.

options.label: The kindest talks him round gently, as one would a frightened child.

outcomes.text: He weeps as he lets them go, begging you to come back and visit. You will not.

options.label: Force your way past him; your own are in there.

outcomes.text: He fights like a cornered animal, but you get through. The breathing in the dark is one of yours.

options.label: The shrewdest offers him something else to keep him company.

outcomes.text: He takes a pot and a blanket in exchange for a Scion, and counts the stitches in the blanket twice.
